explanation: The image → edit → animation approach was appropriate, but avoiding meaningful task labels and time slots weakened the service demonstration; the catalogue’s misleading warning about text rendering contributed. The edited endpoint visibly remains scattered, yet the plan animates toward it without inspection or correction. It also relies on generation settings rather than enforcing the final aspect ratio and removing generated audio.
better_chain: image (create a simple blue-and-white interface with four readable, short tasks) → image-edit (preserve those tasks and organize them into clearly labeled daily time slots, using a text-capable model) → check (verify the same tasks form a recognizable daily plan; revise if necessary) → crop (conform both endpoints to 16:9) → image-to-video (animate the verified messy-to-organized transformation) → assemble (finish at exactly 8 seconds and 16:9, explicitly discarding source audio) → text-overlay (display ClearDay during the final two seconds) → gate (verify transformation, title, duration, aspect, and silence)

steps.issue: The tool fits, but blank cards and abstract marks provide weak evidence of actual tasks. The prompt should specify a small, recognizable task set and simple readable labels rather than avoid lettering entirely.

Editing the initial interface is appropriate, but the prompt lacks concrete time slots and task assignments. The resulting endpoint still has scattered cards rather than the requested organized daily plan and needed correction.

The supplied end image does not depict the required organized state, so animating between these inputs cannot reliably demonstrate the service. Requesting silence and 16:9 from the generator also does not enforce those properties.
A timed text overlay is appropriate for guaranteeing the exact ending name. A designed logo was not required, and the title is correctly scheduled for the last two seconds.

missing: Inspect and repair the organized endpoint before animation; explicitly conform the final video to 8 seconds and 16:9, remove all audio, and verify those properties.
